name: gumloop
description: Gumloop MCP server with 92 tools: 50 reads and 42 confirmed operations.
long_description: Current REST operations with private named credentials and user/team identity selection. Account changes, agent/flow runs, uploads, MCP execution and deletions require explicit confirmation. Binary downloads and signed result URLs go to exclusive private files. Account and GUI outcomes remain separate from fixture/protocol validation.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse account changes, agent/flow execution, uploads, MCP execution and deletions.

api_key.title: Private Gumloop API key
api_key.description: API key from your account; leave empty for token_file.

allow_operations.title: Allow explicitly confirmed account operations
allow_operations.description: Allow only explicitly confirmed account operations and executions.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: User ID from your private Profile Settings; needed for flow endpoints.

team_id.title: Team ID
team_id.description: Optional team ID; legacy API calls it project_id.
